bio.text: Jim Boyd has represented District 20 in the Florida Senate since being elected in 2020, after serving in the Florida House of Representatives from 2010 to 2018.
Boyd works in insurance and investments, was born in Bradenton, and earlier served on the Palmetto City Council from 1988 to 1991.
Boyd holds a B.S. from Florida State University (1978); Boyd's grandfather and uncle also served in the Florida Legislature.
